units.title: Repair session startup, turn-end projection handling, and hook recurrence evidence
units.objective: Keep corrupt sessions fail-safe, make fresh startup fast, prevent stale derived state from permanently blocking ordinary turn end, and aggregate existing content-free receipts without weakening mutation or lane-close gates.

included: Bounded stale-projection repair or safe degradation at ordinary turn end
Content-free hook recurrence reporting through the existing receipt and Plan 111 feedback seams
Focused regression and authentic startup evidence
excluded: session_lifecycle.py cursor-transfer receipt work owned by the coordinated sibling lane
Weakening pre-write mutation or actual lane-close gates

outputs: Turn-end stale-projection repair or degradation receipt
Exact-receipt recurrence report and lifecycle vocabulary
Focused both-sign and authentic startup evidence

acceptance.criterion: Corrupt-session recovery is stable across rollout growth while a fresh session remains accepted.
acceptance.negative_control: Malformed current history never becomes an allowed resume.

acceptance.criterion: A completed-claim-heavy registry cannot force an unbounded heartbeat/projection rebuild on SessionStart, and interrupted derived state cannot permanently block ordinary turn end.
acceptance.negative_control: Pre-write and session-close retain fail-closed behavior.

acceptance.criterion: Existing content-free receipts produce recurrence groups with exact receipt IDs and explicit Plan 111 disposition guidance.
acceptance.negative_control: No prompt/response content or duplicate feedback store is introduced.
